summary: Property Onboarding + AR Room Scan feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (gate 403/open routes, state shape, geocode clean 503, staticmap 502/422, property create/update + street fallback + 400 without lat/lng, rooms CRUD with scan_data merge + cascade delete, items CRUD with blank->null + ownership 404s, upload/files via Bearer and ?token=, AI suggest on a real kitchen photo returned room_type=kitchen + 6 items). Frontend (390x844): demo login -> /onboarding gate, Find address shows 503 notice, Skip setup -> tabs, Rentals setup-card -> /onboarding; new account register -> seeded property prefill w/ map fallback -> rooms (starter 4, delete, add laundry -> room screen), room screen (AR-unavailable notice, upload JPEG, working state, photo strip, AI suggestions add/dismiss/add-all, photo tagger, manual item add/edit/delete, edit room type+label, Room done -> Done badge), review (stats, item edit via sheet, finish -> celebrate -> tabs), Rentals setup-card '<name> · 4 rooms · 6 tagged items' -> /onboarding/rooms, rooms-skip -> finishes with address only, direct URL nav while gated redirects to /onboarding, header logout works, Fix-it/Snap/Bench load. ONE real bug: photo-tagger frame_point is saved as {x:null,y:null} on web (pin rendered at wrong place). Deprecated API detected: expo-image-manipulator manipulateAsync.

minor.issue: frame_point/position are untyped dicts; backend accepted frame_point {x:null,y:null} (from the web NaN bug). Validate as {x: float 0..1, y: float 0..1} and position {x,y,z: float}.
App's 502 body is replaced by Cloudflare's HTML 502 page at the ingress (expected-ish; frontend falls back to drawn pin correctly). Consider 503 or 424 if a JSON detail is ever needed by clients.

Uses startswith('/api/files') etc. without trailing slash, so any future route like /api/filesX or /api/uploads-* would bypass the gate. Use ('/api/auth/', '/api/onboarding', '/api/upload', '/api/files/') with exact-or-slash matching.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, Pressable onPress nativeEvent has no locationX/locationY -> x,y = NaN; NaN fails neither `<0` nor `>1` checks so the item is saved with frame_point {x:null,y:null}. Pin then renders at the image's top-left corner (partly offscreen) instead of where the user tapped, and the photo badge still counts it as '1 tagged'. Verified in DB. Fix: const ne = e.nativeEvent; const lx = ne.locationX ?? ne.offsetX; const ly = ne.locationY ?? ne.offsetY; and guard with Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(y). Reference: /app/frontend/src/onboarding/PhotoTagger.tsx:31-36

issues: AI suggested room_type 'kitchen' for a room typed 'laundry' but room-type-hint only appears when room.type === 'other' — consider showing the hint whenever AI type differs
suggestion-N-add has no busy guard — rapid double tap can create duplicate items; addAll partial failure leaves already-added items in the suggestion list (duplicates on retry)
Onboarding-created property with no amenities shows 'All covered' badge + 'No amenities yet' (contradictory)
Fix-it empty state says 'Add your rentals...' even though the user just added a rental via onboarding

react_native_issues.issue: manipulateAsync is @deprecated in expo-image-manipulator 58 (replaced by contextual API ImageManipulator.manipulate(uri).resize(...).renderAsync() then image.saveAsync({compress, format})). Also resize width:1280 upscales smaller photos. Reference: /app/frontend/src/onboarding/shared.ts:3,99

rca_of_issue: PhotoTagger frame_point null: RN-web Pressable onPress delivers a click event whose nativeEvent is a DOM MouseEvent without locationX/locationY (RN-web only populates those on responder/touch events). (undefined - rect.x)/rect.w = NaN; NaN < 0 and NaN > 1 are both false so the guard passes; JSON.stringify(NaN) -> null, and the backend accepts the untyped dict. Repro: open room-photo-0, click anywhere on photo-tagger-canvas, save item -> db.items.frame_point == {x:None,y:None}; pin appears at top-left. Mitigation: fallback to offsetX/offsetY (or use onPressIn/onResponderRelease which carry locationX on web), Number.isFinite guard, and backend validation.
